subject: Midcycle commit sync and penalty waiver request
messages:
From: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@skylineai.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@skylineai.com
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: Unexpected mid-cycle overage charge on Nov 1 invoice

Jonas —

We just received the invoice that posted this morning and there’s a large line item for usage on Nov 1 that pushed us >20% over our monthly commit. We’re mid-cycle and didn’t change any traffic patterns from our end. Attached is our internal meter for the day, but the spike on your invoice (tokenized requests) doesn’t match what our gateway shows.

Can you help explain what triggered the overage? If this was a transient sampling issue on Redwood’s end, we’ll need a provisional credit while this is investigated — our Q4 budgets are locked and the finance team will not process this payment until reconciled.

Attachments: skyline-meter-nov01.csv

Thanks,
Aaron Patel
Director of Platform Engineering
Skyline AI

---

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@skylineai.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2027 15:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle overage charge on Nov 1 invoice

Aaron — thanks for the flag. I’m sorry for the surprise here. I’ve looped in Ben from Billing and Marissa (your AM) to pull the tenant-level telemetry and start a sampling review.

Quick notes:
- We see a short burst at 07:14 UTC on Nov 1 tied to a rehydration event on one of your ingestion pipelines (internal tag: skyline-replay).
- That event generated amplified token counts due to a serializer mismatch in our streaming proxy that caused several requests to be counted twice in the windowing pass.

We’re generating the raw sample export now and will attach the CSV with per-request IDs. Ben — can you confirm whether this qualifies for a provisional post-pay credit while ops validates?

I’ll keep finance@skylineai.com on the thread for traceability.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Director, Customer Billing & Accounts
Redwood Inference

---

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@skylineai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 2 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle overage charge on Nov 1 invoice

Aaron / team —

I pulled the sampled logs and ran a delta reconciliation against Skyline’s supplied CSV. Summary:

- Root cause: transient double-counting in the token aggregator during a rollout we deployed to streaming-proxy v1.8.4 at 07:12 UTC. The rollout caused ~3.6K requests to be processed twice in the aggregation window.
- Impact: ~1.1M additional tokens attributed to skyline-main (approx 0.4% of your monthly commit), concentrated in a 18-minute window.
- Evidence: attached usage-sampling-nov01.csv (fields: request_id, timestamp_utc, model, tokens_counted_redwood, tokens_counted_customer, sha256(request_payload_sample)).

Recommended remediation steps:
1) Grant a provisional credit for the excess tokens while we run a two-day backfill validation.
2) If validation confirms the double-counting, we’ll apply a post-pay adjustment on the next billing run and issue a credit memo.
3) Engineering will push a hotfix to stop the aggregator from re-processing replay traces. Change is scheduled and tested for rollout tonight.

I’m prepared to put a hold on collection for this invoice (status: pending investigation) and communicate the provisional credit amount to Skyline’s finance team. Proposed provisional credit: USD 2,600 (covers the miscount plus buffer).

Let me know if you need formal evidence (signed audit export) for procurement — we can produce an authenticated CSV and a short explanation note.

Ben Carter
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
Attachment: usage-sampling-nov01.csv

---

From: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@skylineai.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, finance@skylineai.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 10:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle overage charge on Nov 1 invoice

Thanks, Ben / Jonas —

Appreciate the fast response and the initial investigation. The sample CSV you attached lines up with our request IDs in 99.7% of cases — those double-counted request_ids match exactly. We’re comfortable with a provisional credit while you complete the backfill.

A couple asks from our side before we close the hold:
1) Please include the provisional credit as a line item on the invoice PDF so our AP team sees the re-stated total (they require visible credits for payment release).
2) We’ll need the signed audit export for our procurement team (PDF or digitally signed CSV) — can you provide that once the backfill is done?
3) Marissa — can you confirm this won’t count against our monthly bursting allowance or trigger a penalty under the enterprise commit?

If you can confirm 1–3 by EOD Friday we’ll proceed to release the current payment pending the final memo.

Best,
Aaron

---

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: Aaron Patel <aaron.patel@skylineai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, finance@skylineai.com
Date: Wed, 3 Nov 2027 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle overage charge on Nov 1 invoice

Aaron — quick update and confirmations: 

1) Provisional credit: we’ve applied a provisional credit of USD 2,600; invoice-20271101.pdf attached (redline shows credit line and provisional total). This will be reflected in the AP portal immediately and in your invoice PDF.
2) Signed audit export: Ben will deliver a digitally signed CSV and an accompanying explainers.pdf once the backfill completes (expected by EOD Thursday).
3) Commit/penalty: Marissa confirms this incident is an operational billing error and will not count toward burst penalties or affect your committed usage calculations. We will also mark the incident in your customer record to avoid automated alerts.

Action items:
- Ben: finish backfill validation and attach signed CSV + explainers.pdf (ETA Thu EOD).
- Marissa: update Skyline’s account notes and confirm in HubSpot.
- Jonas: keep finance@skylineai.com looped until final memo is delivered.

We appreciate the patience — apologies again for the disruption. I’ll send the final credit memo once validation completes.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Senior Director, Customer Billing & Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachments: invoice-20271101.pdf
